purpose: Pre-capture scene evidence planning. This template contains no fixed gold answers and must not be exposed as model input.

scope.complex_question_groups: Do not extend until the basic mechanism controls and evidence graph have passed manual audit.

protocol_boundary.current_oracle_protocol: Keep the current oracle protocol explicitly oracle-based. RGB review does not change the provenance of oracle state or convert it into visual history.
protocol_boundary.future_visual_protocol: Design and review a new generator protocol before producing any dataset that claims visual-history evidence.

camera_capture_requirements.camera_agent_carried_objects: Plan captures separately from objects carried by the camera agent; record visibility constraints and do not assume carried objects are scene evidence.
camera_capture_requirements.joint_visibility_negative_controls: When needed, capture devices and their contents jointly visible as a negative control.

bbox_threshold.meaning: A bounding-box threshold is only a configurable visibility sanity check. It is not semantic proof that a predicate is visually discriminable.

camera_capture_requirements.duplicate_rgb: Exact duplicate frames are informational and are not automatically a bug; check intended phase, viewpoint and evidence role.

inference_rules.premise_requirement: Infer an unobserved outcome FROM permitted visual/public history, event evidence and declared rules. Hidden simulator metadata is for validation only and must never be used as a model-visible premise.

review.notes: Complete the per-role, per-predicate and per-phase capture plan and review its evidence graph before generation.
